Title: Public IP prefix static IP addresses meter ID changes

Body.Content:
Effective April 1, 2020, the resource GUIDs (also known as meter IDs) of public IP prefix standard static IP addresses in the US Gov region will change. There are no price changes.

Here are the impacted resource GUIDs.
